PITTSBURGH


, Nov. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. (NYSE: PNC) today announced that its Board of Directors has elected Mark Wiedman, president of PNC, as a director of the Corporation. In connection with his election, the Board has increased the number of directors from 13 to 14.


Wiedman joined PNC as president in April 2025 and oversees the company's primary operating lines of business and Regional Presidents Office.


"Mark has played an important role in advancing our growth strategy and strengthening our ability to execute across the franchise," said William S. Demchak, chairman and chief executive officer of PNC. "His experience, strategic perspective and deep understanding of our businesses will be valuable as we continue to build on PNC's momentum and position the company for long-term success."


The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is one of the largest diversified financial services institutions in the United States, organized around its customers and communities for strong relationships and local delivery of retail and business banking including a full range of lending products; specialized services for corporations and government entities, including corporate banking, real estate finance and asset-based lending; wealth management and asset management. For information about PNC, visit[www.pnc.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4829227-1&h=3481050264&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pnc.com%2F&a=www.pnc.com) .
